name: JGC Holdings Corporation
summary: JGC Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides engineering, procurement, and construction services. It operates in two segments, Comprehensive Engineering, and Functional Materials Manufacturing. The Total Engineering segment is involved in the planning, design, procurement, construction, and commissioning services of machinery, facilities and plants for petroleum, petroleum refining, petrochemicals, gas, liquefied natural gas, etc. The Functional Materials Manufacturing segment manufacture and distributes products in catalyst, nanoparticle technology, hygiene and safety, electronic materials, and high-performance ceramic, and next generation energy sectors.
